notes.decision: Fits with guardrails. The governed backlog switch is a settings card on Admin > Platform Development, beside the contribution policy that persists to the same PlatformDevConfig singleton. One toggle and one Save; the daily cap and the Living Playbook explanation sit under a disclosure. No new route or navigation.
notes.persona: The platform operator turns Build Studio's governed backlog lane on so triaged items start without a click per draft, sets how many the daily sweep tees up, and sees in one place which host switch governs phase advancement.
notes.reuse: The existing Platform Development page and its server-action pattern (savePlatformDevConfig), the ui/Button primitive for the primary action, theme tokens only.
notes.sourceTruth: PlatformDevConfig.governedBacklogEnabled and backlogTeeUpDailyCap, read by promoteBacklogItemToBuildDraft, the daily tee-up sweep, capacity drain and the build actions; DPF_BUILD_AUTONOMOUS_PLAYBOOK_MODE read by getAutonomousPlaybookMode.
